run_adsorption_relaxation: run an AdsorptionRunner to relax adsorbate plus surface configurations and compute adsorption energy
calculate_adsorption_chunk: calculate adsorption relaxation results for a specific job chunk using AdsorptionRunner calculate method
write_adsorption_results: write adsorption calculation results to a compressed JSON file using AdsorptionRunner write_results method
review_adsorption_runner_class: review the AdsorptionRunner class and its relaxation parameters like fmax, steps, and relax_surface
refactor_adsorption_optimizer: refactor the AdsorptionRunner to use a different ASE optimizer class instead of LBFGS
